scope: Independent read-only generic candlestick styling semantics, affine price geometry and color/noncolor role review; immutable public/source byte preservation. No market calculations, numerical research revalidation or actual browser claims.
manual_findings: Adaptive domain includes every OHLC and authored level/band; one affine transform preserves body percentages, stops and R target distances.
Slim solid green/purple bodies and thin wicks retain the light chart; roles are conveyed by signal outline+triangle, measurement shading, dashed breaker and text keys.
100% retracement remains R.open rather than the outer wick. Continuation candle identities/counts and payoff physical-bar interpretation are unchanged.
SVG titles/descriptions, per-candle role titles and compact links to complete pattern keys remain available; root browser QA separately verifies live layout and interactions.
